Naples Grape Festival

When is Naples Grape Festival and what's there?

Naples Grape Festival runs Sep 26–27, 2026 in Naples (village), 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.. The village's big harvest weekend, built around Concord grapes and the World's Greatest Grape Pie Contest on Saturday. Add local wine and cider tastings, crafts and live music. Proceeds support the Naples Historical Society and Rotary.
